# C-JOB's own invoice for 30.00, spending the 50.00 credit the payment of its
# job's invoice left. The credit is bigger than the invoice, so the import
# divides it: 30.00 settles INV-C2 and 20.00 stays C-JOB's credit.
#
# TXN_GUID and SPLIT_GUID are the credit's transaction and split, filled in
# by the test.
invoice "INV-C2"
	customer_id: "C-JOB"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "More work"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-03-01
		ar_account: "Receivable"
		memo: "INV-C2"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 50.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-10
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
